title: Integral stages and scalar comparisons
statement: The original integral_stage, coefficient_stage, fixed_coefficient_stage declarations of integral counit realization, with their unchanged hypotheses and conclusions: each supplied integral tower model yields a Stage recording the normalized Hom adjunction and fixed counit; the same model system yields coefficient comparisons and the square for every specified exceptional adjunction.

source.place: Purity transport Steps 1--4; relocation of the existing integral_stage, coefficient_stage, fixed_coefficient_stage declarations

proof.text:
Apply [det-sp-tower-gamma](2)--(3) and [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection]. They give the natural Hom bijection $B_{M,K}:\operatorname{Hom}(FM,K)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(M,HK)$, with the exact three tower comparisons displayed in the latter statement, and $g=\gamma^H:J\xrightarrow{\sim}H$. Define
$$\Phi_{M,K}(h)=g_K^{-1}\circ B_{M,K}(h),\qquad \Phi_{M,K}^{-1}(a)=\varepsilon^H_K\circ F(g_K\circ a).$$
These maps are inverse since $B^{-1}(b)=\varepsilon^H_K\circ F(b)$. Naturality follows from naturality of $B,g$. Hence $\Phi$ is the asserted adjunction $F\dashv J$; its counit is $\Phi^{-1}_{JK,K}(1)=\varepsilon^H_K\circ F(g_K)$ and its unit is $g_{FM}^{-1}\circ\eta^H_M$. This is the elementary transport of the given Hom bijections, with both directions explicitly fixed.

source.place: Step 2, realize the actual tower morphism and transport the Hom adjunction

proof.text: For any specified adjunction for the same left functor, apply det-sp-unique-right-adjoint. Its comparison delta from the realized right adjoint to the specified right adjoint preserves the counit. Functoriality then gives epsilon F(delta gammaH) = epsilonH F(gammaH), the fixed_counit equation. This calculation only uses the supplied adjunctions, not an existence theorem for a new right adjoint.

source.place: Step 3, counit-preserving identification with the chosen exceptional adjoint

proof.text: The supplied realized adjunction has its recorded finite unit and counit reduction equations by det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection. The proved generic transported_unit_reduction and transported_counit_reduction formulas insert the same gammaH inverse or gammaH under reduction. These are exactly the finite unit and counit fields of Stage. No statement about a simultaneously chosen trace system is used by this construction.

source.place: Steps 1--2 and 4, finite reductions and the reconstructed coherent family

proof.text:
For $E\subset F$ let $C_T=-\otimes^L_{R_{E,T}}R_{F,T}$. Clause (1) of [det-sp-field-extension-towers] identifies this actual scalar functor and its tower reductions; clause (2) realizes the finite comparison maps and preserves $\eta^H,\varepsilon^H,g$. Let $b:C_YF_E\simeq F_FC_X$, $s:C_XH_E\simeq H_FC_Y$ and $a:C_XJ_E\simeq J_FC_Y$ denote those comparisons. They satisfy $s\,C_X(g_E)=g_Fa$ and $\varepsilon^H_F\circ F_F(s)\circ b_{H_E}=C_Y(\varepsilon^H_E)$. Substitution in $t^E=\varepsilon^H_EF_E(g_E)$, using naturality of $b$, gives
$$t^F\circ F_F(a)\circ b_{J_E}=C_Y(t^E).$$
Substitution in $g_E^{-1}\eta^H_E$ gives the unit comparison. The same cited clause supplies transitivity for $E\subset F\subset L$. Finally form the counit-preserving comparisons $\delta_E$ and $\delta_F$ by [det-sp-unique-right-adjoint]. Their unit and counit equations show that conjugating the realized exceptional scalar comparison gives a comparison for the specified exceptional adjunctions, with the same left comparison. Substitute $\gamma^T_E=\delta_Eg_E$ in the purity square and cancel $\delta_E^{-1}\delta_E$. This proves compatibility with the actual maps. The same cancellation preserves the coefficient cocycles. No separate coefficient-uniqueness theorem is required.
